name: Fairmont Pacific Rim
positioning: Art-focused Fairmont hotel in the heart of Vancouver, with mountain and harbour views
best_for: Travelers who enjoy art, design and a stylish city base
Guests who want harbour and mountain views from their room

facts.text: Fairmont Pacific Rim is located in the heart of Vancouver.
The Pacific Gallery is an intimate exhibition space showing works by established and emerging artists from Canada and around the world, in partnership with the Equinox Gallery and Westbank.
Dining and drinking venues include the restaurant Botanist, Botanist Bar, and The Lobby Lounge & RawBar, which serves sushi and drinks.
Giovane is a more casual Italian bakery and cafe serving pasta, pizza, panini and desserts.
Fairmont Spa is on the fifth floor of the hotel.
Guest rooms and suites have Stearns & Foster beds, marble bathrooms and a variety of city and mountain views.
Signature Ofuro rooms have a Japanese deep soaker ofuro jetted tub in an oversized marble bathroom, with views of Coal Harbour and the North Shore Mountains.
The hotel has a spa, a rooftop pool and a fitness center.
Deluxe Partial Harbour View rooms look over the city and part of the harbour, where seaplanes and sailboats can be seen.
The northern view takes in the living roof of the Vancouver Convention Centre across the street, Burrard Inlet and the North Shore Mountains.

highlights.text: Suite X, a Fairmont Gold one-bedroom suite, was designed by artist Douglas Coupland and has a private patio, artist-designed art installations and custom furnishings.
The Chairmans Suite is a two-story, villa-style suite with a private gazebo, pond and fire pit, reached by private elevator.
Deluxe Pool View rooms have private patios or balconies, some with outdoor fireplaces, overlooking the pool terrace, cabanas and palm trees.
The hotel's art collection was established under the direction of owners and developers Westbank and the Peterson Group.
A dedicated library on the second floor holds over 275 TASCHEN books, from artist monographs to signed Collector's Editions.

considerations.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
Vancouver International Airport is around 30-40 minutes from the hotel by car and 40 minutes by Skytrain; the closest Skytrain station is Waterfront.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a bustling downtown district, which may not suit guests seeking a quiet, secluded retreat.
